visit.Description: Visit number (the session label is the number of the MRI ID)

pathology.Description: Group of the participant across the study (converted: nondemented at the first visit, demented at a later one)

ses.Description: Socioeconomic status, assessed by the Hollingshead Index of Social Position and classified into categories from 1 (highest status) to 5 (lowest status) (Hollingshead, 1957).

mmse.Description: Mini-Mental State Examination. Ranges from 0 (worst) to 30 (best) (Folstein, Folstein, & McHugh, 1975)

cdr.Description: Clinical Dementia Rating (Morris, 1993). All participants with dementia (CDR >0) were diagnosed with probable AD.

nwbv.Description: Normalized Whole Brain Volume, expressed as a percent of all voxels in the atlas-masked image that are labeled as gray or white matter by the automated tissue segmentation process (Fotenos et al., 2005)

asf.Description: Atlas Scaling Factor. Computed scaling factor that transforms native-space brain and skull to the atlas target (i.e., the determinant of the transform matrix) (Buckner et al., 2004)
